syntax.syntax_item: P = tessera.poisson_disk(width, height, radius, k, seed)

param_input_item.param_description: Minimum distance between any two samples.
Seed of the pseudo-random generator (default 0). The same seed reproduces the same field.

param_output_item.param_description: An N-by-2 [x y] matrix of sampled points.

description.p: Draw a blue-noise point set with Bridson's Poisson-disk algorithm: points are randomly but evenly spread so that no two are closer than radius. Ideal for natural-looking scattering of objects, stippling and jittered sampling.

xmldoc.bibliography: M. Hendrikx, S. Meijer, J. van der Velden, A. Iosup, Procedural Content Generation for Games: A Survey, ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications and Applications 9(1), 2013. DOI 10.1145/2422956.2422957.

example_item.example_item_data: P = tessera.poisson_disk(500, 500, 12); plot(P(:, 1), P(:, 2), '.'); axis equal
